title: Moses Returns to His Mother, Then Flees

paragraphs.text: Allah had already stopped Moses from feeding from any nurse. So his sister offered to show them a family who would take good care of him. In this way, Allah returned him to his mother so that she could be happy and know that His promise is true. When Moses grew up and became mature, Allah gave him wisdom and knowledge.

One day Moses entered the city and found two men fighting, one from his own people and one from his enemy. When his man called for help, Moses struck the other, and the man died, although Moses had not meant to kill him. He said this was the work of Satan, and he asked his Lord to forgive him, and Allah forgave him. He promised never to help criminals. The next day, the same man called for help again, and Moses told him that he was clearly a troublemaker. When Moses was about to strike their enemy, the man said Moses wanted to be a tyrant. Then someone ran to warn Moses that the chiefs were planning to kill him, so he left the city in fear, praying to be saved.

Moses travelled toward Madyan, hoping that Allah would guide him. At a well, he saw two women holding back their animals, waiting until the shepherds had finished, because their father was very old. He watered their flocks and then rested in the shade, telling his Lord that he needed any good He sent. Later, one of the women came shyly and invited him to meet her father, who comforted him. She advised her father to hire Moses, since he was strong and trustworthy. The father offered him a daughter in marriage if he worked eight years, or ten as a favor, and Moses agreed.

hardWords.m: fully grown in body and mind
to give someone a job for pay
